meta.title: OpenCode Accounts & Usage
meta.description: One plugin for all of OpenCode: an account pool (add a key with a note, automatic A-to-B failover, switch / disable / re-key / delete), per-account 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowance, per-model spend with capability tags (image, video, text-only, tool calls, context size), and a live "OpenCode vs. official API" cost comparison.
